m.chalisa.do1: Śāradā, a self-manifest image, has come to Maihar and is enthroned there, holding a rosary and a book, with the vīṇā adorning her hand.
m.chalisa.cau1: Victory, victory, victory to Śāradā, the great queen; you are the primal Śakti, who brings welfare to the world.
m.chalisa.cau2: Mother, your form has four arms; you are famed in the three worlds.
m.chalisa.cau3: About two thousand years ago, as it is reckoned, Śāradā appeared; the world knows it.
m.chalisa.cau4: The town of Maihar is famed throughout the world, where Śāradā, mother of the world, is seated.
m.chalisa.cau5: Śāradā dwells on the mountain Trikūṭa; the town of Maihar shines with supreme light.
m.chalisa.cau6: Your face is like the autumn moon; your four-armed form is exceedingly lovely.
m.chalisa.cau7: The pure radiance of your body is like ten million suns; the royal swan is your vehicle.
m.chalisa.cau8: Swinging earrings look lovely in your ears; the jewel on your breast and your forehead appear beyond compare.
m.chalisa.cau9: You hold the vīṇā, the book and the gesture of fearlessness; you are the mother of the world, and you move through the world.
m.chalisa.cau10: You are the daughter of Brahmā, undivided and incomparable; the king of the gods sings Śāradā's virtues.
m.chalisa.cau11: Viṣṇu and Śiva bow to Śāradā; Varuṇa and Kubera pay her honour.
m.chalisa.cau12: Śāradā's form came down as the Caṇḍī incarnation, who slew the demons Caṇḍa and Muṇḍa.
m.chalisa.cau13: The auspicious Śāradā, becoming Durgā, as Bhavānī slew Mahiṣāsura.
m.chalisa.cau14: Taking that form, Śāradā became Caṇḍī, and wearing her garland of heads she cut down Raktabīja in battle.
m.chalisa.cau15: Tulasīdāsa, Sūradāsa and other learned men have always told of Śāradā's fair fame.
m.chalisa.cau16: By your mercy, Mother Śāradā, Kālidāsa became greatly renowned.
m.chalisa.cau17: Vālmīki, Nārada, the sages and the gods serve Śāradā again and again.
m.chalisa.cau18: O Māyā of the world, give me the refuge of your feet; Śāradā's māyā pervades the whole world.
m.chalisa.cau19: Śāradā dwells in every atom and particle, full of supreme power, supreme light.
m.chalisa.cau20: O Śāradā, you are the very form of Brahman; Śiva, Brahmā, men and kings worship you.
m.chalisa.cau21: Between Brahman and Śakti there is not a single difference; the Vedas sing Śāradā's virtues.
m.chalisa.cau22: Victory to you, worshipped by the world, whose form is the universe; without attributes and with attributes, both are Śāradā's forms.
m.chalisa.cau23: Remember Śāradā's name without a break, and the fierce age of Kali will not touch you.
m.chalisa.cau24: The sun, the moon and the stars of the heavens all shine by Śāradā's grace.
m.chalisa.cau25: I bow to Śāradā, who brings about creation, preservation and dissolution, the saviour of the world.
m.chalisa.cau26: By your grace, Mother Śāradā, all sorrow and poverty are destroyed.
m.chalisa.cau27: Mother Śāradā, your knowledge is most pure, the support of the world.
m.chalisa.cau28: Giver of happiness, from you come learning and wisdom. Victory, victory, victory to Śāradā Bhavānī.
m.chalisa.cau29: Those who worship Śāradā surely cross the ocean of worldly existence.
m.chalisa.cau30: By Śāradā's grace pure knowledge is gained, and great good comes in every way.
m.chalisa.cau31: The objects of the world bring great sorrow; by worshipping Śāradā great happiness is gained.
m.chalisa.cau32: Śāradā, your light is supreme; send its divine rays towards me.
m.chalisa.cau33: Whoever remembers Mother Śāradā, his mind is absorbed in supreme bliss.
m.chalisa.cau34: Through japa and meditation the mind grows calm; by worshipping Śāradā knowledge comes.
m.chalisa.cau35: This is a composition made about Śāradā; those who recite it are freed from the round of worldly existence.
m.chalisa.cau36: Whoever reads it with hundreds of salutations and a mind intent on her, Mother Śāradā will bring him good.
m.chalisa.cau37: Who in the world has known Śāradā's glory? The Vedas tell of it, saying: Not this, not this.
m.chalisa.cau38: Hundreds of salutations to you, Śāradā; turn your gracious glance towards me.
m.chalisa.cau39: Those who serve you meet with no heavy sorrow anywhere.
m.chalisa.cau40: Whoever recites this Chālīsā, Mother Śāradā, give him your blessing.
m.chalisa.do2: I bow to the dust of Śāradā's feet; give me devotion and knowledge. Drive away all ignorance, and dwell forever in the home of my heart.
m.chalisa.do3: Victory, victory to Mother Śāradā; Maihar is your abode. Mother, take me into your refuge; I worship you without desire for reward.
